verdict.rationale: The docs describe webhooks that notify you of changes in workflow status, so results can be retrieved by webhook instead of polling. Signatures can be verified by computing an HMAC-SHA256 of the request body with the webhook's secret token, which covers the core of the story: signed, push-based lifecycle notifications. Missing for 10: an explicit list of event types matching created/processing/verified/requires-input, documentation of delivery and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
